changes.to: Noetix no longer lists Dora: its founder said in a March 2025 interview that Dora became the E1 after the tooling was consolidated, and the maker's current catalogue has no Dora page (checked 2026-11-17). Third-party figures (100 cm, 20 kg, 20 DoF) are not used.
Noetix's compact service humanoid from 2024, later folded into the E1 line; the maker no longer documents it.
